tasks.name: Design Problem Library UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for browsing and searching problems in the library.

tasks.name: Implement Problem Library Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend to manage problem data, including fetching, filtering, and searching.

tasks.name: Set Up Problem Database
tasks.description: Design and implement the database schema for storing problem details.

tasks.name: Develop Code Submission UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for users to submit their code for evaluation.

tasks.name: Implement Code Evaluation System
tasks.description: Develop the backend logic to compile, run, and evaluate submitted code against test cases.

tasks.name: Design User Profile UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for displaying user profiles, including solved problems and statistics.

tasks.name: Implement User Profile Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend to manage user data, including profile details and activity tracking.

tasks.name: Create Leaderboard UI
tasks.description: Design the frontend interface for displaying the leaderboard with user rankings.

tasks.name: Implement Leaderboard Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend logic to calculate and update user rankings based on problem-solving performance.

tasks.name: Add Hints and Explanations UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface to display hints and explanations for problems.

tasks.name: Implement Hints and Explanations Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend to manage hints and explanations for problems.

tasks.name: Test Problem Library Functionality
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure the problem library works as expected.

tasks.name: Test Code Submission and Evaluation
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure the code submission and evaluation system works correctly.

tasks.name: Test User Profiles
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure user profiles display correct data and statistics.

tasks.name: Test Leaderboard Functionality
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure the leaderboard updates and displays rankings correctly.

tasks.name: Test Hints and Explanations
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure hints and explanations are displayed correctly.

tasks.name: Deploy ACM Problem-Solving Platform
tasks.description: Deploy the platform to a production environment.

T1.implementation_approach: Design a user-friendly interface with search, filter, and categorization options for problems.
T1.notes: Ensure responsive design for compatibility across devices.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful APIs to handle problem retrieval, creation, and updates.
T2.notes: Focus on scalability and secure data handling.

T3.implementation_approach: Set up a relational database schema to store problem details, tags, and metadata.
T3.notes: Optimize for quick search and retrieval.

T4.implementation_approach: Create an intuitive UI for users to write, test, and submit code solutions.
T4.notes: Include syntax highlighting and error feedback.

T5.implementation_approach: Develop a backend system to compile, execute, and evaluate submitted code against test cases.
T5.notes: Ensure sandboxing for security and resource management.

T6.implementation_approach: Design a profile page displaying user stats, achievements, and activity history.

T7.implementation_approach: Implement backend APIs to manage user data, authentication, and profile updates.
T7.notes: Ensure secure handling of sensitive user information.

T8.implementation_approach: Design a leaderboard UI to display top users with sorting and filtering options.

T9.implementation_approach: Develop backend logic to calculate and update leaderboard rankings in real-time.
T9.notes: Optimize for performance with large datasets.

T10.implementation_approach: Create a UI to display hints and explanations for problems in an accessible format.
T10.notes: Allow toggling hints to avoid spoilers.

T11.implementation_approach: Implement backend APIs to store and retrieve hints and explanations for problems.
T11.notes: Ensure proper versioning for content updates.

T12.implementation_approach: Perform end-to-end testing of the problem library's UI and backend functionality.
T12.notes: Test for edge cases and performance under load.

T13.implementation_approach: Test the code submission and evaluation system with various programming languages and edge cases.
T13.notes: Ensure security and accuracy of the evaluation process.

T14.implementation_approach: Verify user profile features, including data updates, authentication, and UI responsiveness.
T14.notes: Test for data consistency across sessions.

T15.implementation_approach: Test the leaderboard for accurate ranking updates and proper UI functionality.
T15.notes: Simulate high traffic to ensure stability.

T16.implementation_approach: Validate the hints and explanations system for proper content retrieval and display.

T17.implementation_approach: Deploy the platform to a cloud environment with proper CI/CD pipelines.
T17.notes: Ensure monitoring and logging for post-deployment support.
